purpose: Pre-generated V1 artwork for the Moon Descendants faction and Invasion announcement.

usage.note: Pre-generated event artwork. The manifest is a provenance record, not a runtime asset framework. The Invasion key art is the default Telegram announcement photo; photo-send failures remain presentation-only and fall back to text.

art_direction_summary.mood: mature dark fantasy; regal, ancient, supernatural, mysterious, beautiful and intimidating
motifs: gothic lunar halls and ancient territory
avoid: text, frames, borders, logos or watermarks

scenes.description_en: The beautiful, ancient and intimidating Moon Descendant Queen stands beneath a crescent moon in her crystalline throne hall; primary faction style anchor.
A disciplined adult Moon Descendant Knight in ceremonial midnight plate stands before the realm's moonlit gate with a crescent polearm.
An ancient veiled Oracle regards the viewer from a lunar observatory, holding a moonstone astrolabe and an eclipse-lit crystal.
A poised adult Huntress tracks the viewer through her midnight forest with a silver crescent bow and moonstone arrow.
A silent, masked royal Reaper with a black-silver crescent scythe stands before an eclipse and distant lunar spires.
The Queen presides over her disciplined court, flanked by the Knight, Oracle and Huntress in a vast moonlit throne hall.
A monumental lunar temple of dark stone, silver arches, moonstone crystals, reflecting water and veiled guardian statues.
The Queen and her court face a breach at the ancient lunar gates as a beam of cold moonlight awakens the realm and tiny intruders approach.
